name: Vendetta "Stronghold" HMG
description:
Too large to use except with a heavy exo-suit, the Vendetta from Apocalypse Arms is a belt-fed instrument of death. What it lacks in accuracy it makes up for with a high rate of fire for complete target saturation and battlefield dominance.

The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.
